Berit Klinik is looking for a dedicated personality for the storage location. Position: Hotellerie, 100%. Berit Klinik AG | Vögelinsegg 5 | 9042 Memory | +41 71 335 06 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch About the Berit Clinic The Berit Clinic Group operates seven locations in eastern Switzerland and is leading in memory and low-level in orthopaedics, spinal surgery and re habilitation. In Wattwil there is a 24/7 emergency station, a daily clinic, various speaking hours, radiology, a laboratory and the PSA, a short-term therapy for alco- holkranke. In Goldach, the clinic offers hand and peripheral nerve surgery, speaking hours in eye medicine and orthopaedics as well as a Ma-gen-Darm centre. The Berit Sportcli- nic is represented in Memory, Arbon and Heerbrugg. Since 2025, Berit Sportslab in St. Gallen has added the offer in the field of athletics training.
